summary.text: Tina Pickett is the Republican incumbent, in office since December 1, 2000, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 110, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists her profession as business owner.

paragraphs.text: Tina Pickett attended Pennsylvania State University, Keystone College and the Culinary Institute of America.
According to Ballotpedia, she owned Pickett's Dairy from 1964 to 1968, owned the Fireplace Restaurant from 1968 to 1985, and has owned The Williamston Inn since 1977.
Pickett served as a Bradford County commissioner from 1996 to 2000 before taking her House seat in December 2000.
In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Committee on Committees and the Insurance Committee and served on the Rules Committee.
